description: This PHP class defines an entity for US tax exemption details associated with an employee in the OrangeHRM system. It includes properties for federal, state, and unemployment tax details, and uses Doctrine ORM for database mapping. The class also integrates a decorator pattern for additional functionality.

classes.name: EmpUsTaxExemption
classes.description: Entity class representing US tax exemption details for an employee, with ORM mapping annotations and decorator pattern.
